city_status.summary_sr: Vazduh u Beogradu je umerenog kvaliteta; osetljive grupe mogu osetiti blagi uticaj.
city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Povezivač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Observer is right that Belvil now carries the largest displayed shift, and I add the hour: at Thursday 22:37 [F1] free spaces rising from 275 to 396 [F5] fits an evening emptying, though without measurement times from Parking Servis [F4] it stays a shape, not an event. Skeptic's bomb-report pairing is stale; the current links all attach one Blic cable-theft rail headline to unrelated media stories at 0.73–0.74 [F38][F39][F40], which looks like the embedding model orbiting a single salient headline despite surprise ratings of 4/5 [F41]. Meanwhile Tanjug announces parts of Grocka without water tomorrow [F6] while BVK's own fault feed delivered 0 of 24 expected slots [F12] — the announcement traveled through a news agency, not the utility's channel.
